newsitem.title: JAPAN: Court declares Olympic Sports bankrupt.
newsitem.headline: Court declares Olympic Sports bankrupt.

text.p: The Nagoya District Court said on Wednesday that it had declared Olympic Sports Co bankrupt.
The company has debts of 35.51 billion yen, private research company Teikoku Databank Ltd said in a statement.
The company, which operates sporting goods shops and fitness clubs, applied to the court for bankruptcy last week after failing to draw up a reorganisation scheme.
As of the end of March, it had 92 stores and 21 clubs, mostly in the central and northern parts of Japan.
Olympic's business declined due to increased sales costs and severe competition, Teikoku Databank said.
The company's shares are traded on the over-the-counter market, and they fell sharply after it announced last week it would apply for bankruptcy.
The shares were being traded at one yen at 0403 GMT, unchanged from Tuesday's close.
